principle.name: Read-Only Enforcement
principle.description: You are explicitly forbidden from writing, modifying, or executing implementation code. Your sole objective is planning.
principle.rationale: Planning mode must remain orthogonal to execution to maintain clear separation of concerns and enable safe handoff.

example.scenario: User asks to implement a feature
example.good: Generate plan.md with DAG decomposition and context firewalls, then pause for approval
example.bad: Write code for the feature directly

principle.name: 10-Minute Rule
principle.description: Every sub-task must be scoped to execute within a 5-10 minute tool-use window and touch no more than 5 files.
principle.rationale: Prevents reasoning drift in token-constrained environments and ensures each task is completable in one session.

example.good: Split into 6 tasks of 3 files each, with explicit dependencies
example.bad: Create 1 task touching 20 files with no clear boundaries

principle.name: Principle of Least Context
principle.description: For every sub-task, inject only the specific files, functions, and types required for that immediate task.
principle.rationale: Prevents context rot and attention dilution in downstream worker agents.

example.scenario: Task only needs a specific utility function
example.good: Context firewall lists only the utility file and its line range
example.bad: Context firewall includes entire module and all related files

principle.name: Command-Level Granularity
principle.description: Each sub-task must specify exact commands, file paths, line ranges, and expected outputs.
principle.rationale: Ensures a 7B parameter model can execute without hallucination.

example.good: "Run: python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_auth.py::test_login -v. Expected: 1 passed in 0.52s"

principle.name: Single Source of Truth
principle.description: plan.md acts as the living contract. All task state updates reference and modify this single file.
principle.rationale: Prevents plan drift and ensures all stakeholders reference the same artifact.

principle.name: State Archiving
principle.description: Move outdated plans from agentic/plan/ to agentic/plan/archive/ to maintain clean workspace.
principle.rationale: Prevents context dilution from stale plans.

convention.rule: Use standardized checkbox format for task tracking

examples.good: [ ] = Not started, [x] = Completed, [-] = In progress, [!] = Blocked

convention.rule: Every plan.md MUST begin with exact YAML frontmatter structure
convention.template: --- Create Date: YYYY-MM-DD Update Date: YYYY-MM-DD IDE: Roo Code Agent: GitHub committer: ---

guideline.rule: When external references are needed, search GitHub for top-starred repositories

search_strategy.step: Use GitHub search with sort=stars to find most popular projects
Focus on repositories with clear documentation and active maintenance
Document: repo name, star count, URL, and relevance to planning topic

guideline.documentation_format: ## Research Findings - GitHub | Repository | Stars | URL | Relevance | |------------|-------|-----|-----------| | owner/repo | 15k | https://... | Brief description |

guideline.rule: Search Google for the top 5 most relevant results when additional context is needed

search_strategy.step: Use targeted search queries with relevant keywords
Prioritize official documentation, authoritative sources, and recent articles
Capture: title, URL, and key findings for each of the top 5 results

guideline.documentation_format: ## Research Findings - Web Sources 1. **Title**: URL - Key finding summary 2. **Title**: URL - Key finding summary ...

guideline.rule: Document all research findings in plan.md under a Research Findings section
Use research findings to inform architectural decisions and task decomposition
Only conduct research when the planning topic requires external context

pitfall.description: Creating sub-tasks that exceed 5 files or 10 minutes
pitfall.why_problematic: Causes reasoning drift and hallucination in downstream agents
pitfall.correct_approach: Split larger tasks into smaller, atomic sub-tasks with explicit dependencies

pitfall.description: Using ambiguous language in task descriptions
pitfall.why_problematic: 7B models cannot infer intent from vague instructions
pitfall.correct_approach: Specify exact file paths, line ranges, commands, and expected outputs

pitfall.why_problematic: Violates read-only enforcement and blurs mode boundaries
pitfall.correct_approach: Generate plan.md only; signal readiness for execution handoff

pitfall.why_problematic: Agents cannot self-correct without explicit troubleshooting steps
pitfall.correct_approach: Include exact fallback commands for common errors in every sub-task

category.name: before_generating_plan
category.item: Requirements are fully understood and ambiguities resolved
Environmental context mapped (directory structure, existing patterns)

category.name: during_decomposition
category.item: Anti-Hallucination Checklist passed for each sub-task
DAG dependencies are explicit and acyclic
Context Firewalls defined for each sub-task

category.item: Plan archived if replacing an outdated version
